summary: Bundle bndl-08f2159a73227a88 (10:00-10:08 UTC, 2026-11-14, 31 events, complete capture) supports no incident allegation. The integrity audit found no local log removal, no data staging evidence, and no bulk transfer to a non-approved destination. Two 6.4 MB outbound flows from gateway at 10:03:20-22 went to approved destinations (198.51.100.16 review store, 198.51.100.28 archive store) and match svc-delivery queue/archive activity for reports D/R-381 and D/R-382 by timing and byte count only. Both are recorded as policy-consistent, benign explanations (findings F-085f5a and F-a9858c, both kept by the skeptic). Accounts svc-delivery and svc-ingest were used; the human operator is not established and no person is named or cleared.
